_comment: Hand names for 04887050 tables (family A), read from the code; also used for 04887051.

0B18.name: FlexEthanolRpm
0B18.desc: Flex fuel: value against ethanol content (rows) and RpmCurveValue (columns), both as positions; read in FuelCorrections like FlexEthanolRpm in 05293190AC

0C11.name: FlexEthanolCoolantFactor1
0C11.desc: Flex fuel: factor against ethanol content (rows) and coolant, first of the three coolant factors read in FuelCorrections (order as in 05293190AC)

0BB4.name: FlexEthanolCoolantFactor2
0BB4.desc: Flex fuel: second coolant factor against ethanol content and coolant (FuelCorrections)

0CC2.name: FlexEthanolCoolantFactor3
0CC2.desc: Flex fuel: third coolant factor against ethanol content and coolant (FuelCorrections)

09B1.name: AfterStartDecay
09B1.desc: After-start enrichment against time since start (rows) and CrankCoolant (columns); part of the warm-up factor in FuelCorrections

0D1F.name: EgrFuelCorrection
0D1F.desc: 17 x 17 fuel correction against MAP (rows, through PartThrottleMapScale) and rpm, applied in FuelCorrections only while the EGR solenoid is on (ControlFlags944 bit 2); in 05293190AC EgrControl reads PartThrottleFuelMain for this; its rpm axis is the same as that of PartThrottleFuelMain in 05293190AC

180B.name: EgrSpark
180B.desc: Spark correction with EGR on, MAP x rpm (EgrSparkCalc), as EgrSpark in 05293190AC

51F3.name: FuelEventOffset
51F3.desc: FuelEventCalc: FuelEventOffsetIn to column 0..2 (stock curve); added to 3 * CylinderIndex to index the 12-byte per-cylinder table at $51E7.
